title: Ion Drift (SID)
message:
An original action loop for the C64 in the manner of Jeroen Tel (Cybernoid era), written with the sid-music skill.
D minor, 6 frames a row. Voice 1 bass + kick + snare, voice 2 lead / broken-chord figure, voice 3 broken chords /
filtered swell / filtered B melody / harmony. Order 0 plays a 2-bar intro; the loop returns to order 2.
